newsitem.title: USA: Adviser says contacted P & F Industries.
newsitem.headline: Adviser says contacted P & F Industries.

text.p: A group led by San Francisco investment adviser Andrew Shapiro, which holds a 6.7 percent stake in P & F Industries Inc., said Wednesday it has discussed business strategies with the company's management.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the Shapiro group also said it sold a net 62,000 Class A common shares of the company's stock between Nov 29 and Jan 28, leaving it with 197,600 shares.

The group said it has discussed with P & F Industries management and board members matters that included replacing high-cost debt, repurchasing the company's Class A common stock and its acquisition strategy.
The group said it also has been in contact with other P & F Industries shareholders. But it said it has no plan to acquire control of the company.
